title: Love them!
text: Love them!. I love these bottle hangers!  They stick well and so far, support the bottles.  I love the space I now have in my cabinet. I will be buying more.

product_metadata.title: Command Spray Bottle Hangers, 2 pack, 2 hangers, 4 large strips
features: INCLUDES - 2 white hangers, 4 large strips; 1 hanger holds 2.5 lbs
DAMAGE-FREE HANGING- Easily keep your spray bottles out of sight but within reach without causing damage to your wood, paint, or tiled surfaces
NO TOOLS REQUIRED- Simple to install, no tools required and no damage to your cabinet doors or walls
STRONG AND VERSATILE- Command Products hold strongly on a variety of surfaces, including paint, wood, tile and more

description: Meet an easy way to organize spray bottles. The Command Spray Bottle Hanger is great for neatly storing your spray bottles out of sight, but within reach. Simple to install, no tools required and no damage to your cabinet doors or walls. Using Command Adhesive, Command products hold strongly on a variety of surfaces, including paint, wood, tile and more. Removes cleanly, no holes or sticky residue. Reusing our spray bottle holder is easy; simply apply a new Command Refill Strip, and use it again and again.
